review_notes: I read the whole file. The only new concept it defines is `Polynomial.bernoulli`, the Bernoulli polynomial over ℚ, defined from the number `_root_.bernoulli`. I grepped Mathlib for other Bernoulli definitions. The only related one is `bernoulliFun` in Mathlib/NumberTheory/ZetaValues.lean. It is defined as `(Polynomial.map (algebraMap ℚ ℝ) (Polynomial.bernoulli k)).eval x`, so it is a real-valued wrapper built on the target definition, not a competing one. It lives in a different file, and its API (for example `hasDerivAt_bernoulliFun`) is analytic and separate from the polynomial API here. The other Bernoulli-named definitions (`bernoulli'`, `bernoulli`, the power series, `periodizedBernoulli`, `bernoulliFourierCoeff`, and the probability `bernoulli`) are different concepts. I found no other Mathlib definition of Bernoulli polynomials. The file also builds no custom structures or parallel generating-function notion, and the TODO about exponential generating functions is not a duplicate. I found nothing that meets the rubric.
